evidence_items.claim: Arad Ostraca belongs to the material culture of Levantine, Mesopotamian, Egyptian, Persian, Greek, or Roman settings, where inscriptions, architecture, pottery, and administrative remains help contextualize the biblical world.
Arad Ostraca helps anchor the biblical world in physical evidence and archaeological context.

Ancient background for Bibliology includes covenant life, temple worship, royal ideology, wisdom teaching, and early church confession; the entry ties that world to Deuteronomy 6:4-9, Psalm 19:7-11, inspiration, and inerrancy without letting comparison replace the biblical witness.
Bibliology is read across the canon as Scripture develops this theme from Israel's story into the New Testament witness.

Caesarea Maritima Excavations helps anchor the biblical world in physical evidence and archaeological context.
